## Passages
RESULT [webresearch]: PaSa-7B beats Google with GPT-4o by 37.78% on recall@20 and 39.90% on recall@50, and beats PaSa-GPT-4o by 30.36% on recall and 4.25% on precision.
US [webresearch]: Shows that paper search is a narrow skill a 7B open model can learn well enough to beat a frontier model with Google. The crawler/selector split fits the weak-model-plus-verifier tiers we already have. It could also serve for dataset discovery, where the collector currently only queries GitHub/Kaggle/HF search APIs.
CORRECTION [webresearch]: The key_result numbers match the abstract verbatim, and ACL 2025 (long) is confirmed. The key_idea has an error: only the Crawler is RL-trained (imitation learning, then PPO). The Selector is supervised fine-tuning only, one epoch. Both are Qwen2.5-7B based.
